sources.title: GitHub - xgirls-dev/fern: A local image studio powered by OpenVINO.
sources.snippet: Fern is a private Windows image studio for running Flux.2 Klein 9B locally with one shared model and a hardware-specific OpenVINO device. Intel, NVIDIA, and CPU execution all use the same xgirls INT4 OpenVINO release at xgirls/FLUX.2-klein-9B-ov-int4. NVIDIA execution uses the NVIDIA device from the OpenVINO NVIDIA plugin.

sources.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein: open weights, 5.6B parameters
sources.snippet: In internal evaluations, FLUX 3 Image Klein ranks first in text-to-image, multi-reference generation and image editing, ahead of larger open weights models. It also rates above the closed models in the comparison, Ideogram V4.5 and FLUX.2 [pro]. sources.title: Black Forest Labs Releases FLUX 3 Image Klein With 5.6B Parameters
sources.snippet: Black Forest Labs has released FLUX 3 Image Klein, a 5.6B parameter image model with downloadable weights, support for 8GB GPUs and API pricing starting at $0.009 per 1K image.
